description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Natural Products Journal is hiring a Software Engineer to implement scoped improvements, investigate defects, and support routine software releases. The role works from defined technical requirements and confirms expected outcomes before changes are released.
Software Engineer developing code, debugging defects, handling APIs and validation, and assisting with feature-related data modeling

Responsibilities:
• Write readable code that follows existing project conventions
• Investigate reported defects and reproduce issues before fixing them
• Document important implementation decisions and technical limitations
• Assist with database queries or data models when relevant to a feature
• Follow established practices for handling credentials and sensitive data
• Use Git to manage and review changes to the codebase
• Work with APIs and handle ordinary data validation or error cases

Requirements:
• Ability to write and interpret simple automated tests
• Experience through coursework, internships, or personal projects is acceptable
• Understanding of functions, data structures, and common debugging techniques
• Comfort reading API documentation and existing code
• Ability to work independently on well-defined tasks in a remote team
• Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States
